findings.title: Reconnect 're-save answers' has no server endpoint for mid-exam MCQ saves
findings.problem: MCQ selections are only persisted inside /submit (which finalizes and scores and requires status=='In Progress'); there is no incremental MCQ-save route and no localStorage buffering. 'Extend autosave to MCQ selections' names an unspecified flow. Reusing /submit would prematurely finalize the attempt.
findings.fix: Pick one and specify it: (a) add POST /api/assessment/<id>/autosave with ownership + In-Progress guard that upserts partial answers (e.g. assessment_attempts.draft_answers JSON via the same guarded migration) without scoring, read as fallback in /submit; or (b) buffer answers in localStorage keyed by attempt_id and drop the server 'extend to MCQ' claim.

findings.title: New candidate routes omit @login_required_with_session used by every other candidate route
findings.problem: All existing candidate routes stack @login_required and @login_required_with_session; the new routes specify only @login_required. Ownership helper covers the IDOR but the session guard is inconsistent.
findings.fix: State the new candidate routes use @login_required + @login_required_with_session + _own_attempt(attempt_id), matching the existing stack.

findings.title: Migration is manual and db.create_all() will not ALTER existing tables
findings.problem: SQLAlchemy create_all never ALTERs existing tables, so new model columns do not exist until the .sql is hand-run; raw inserts referencing them fail at runtime if the migration lags the code deploy.
findings.fix: Add a deploy note that the .sql must run before deploying the new Main.py; optionally a startup information_schema presence check that logs a clear error if unapplied.

findings.title: detection_source column default 'client' requires every server insert to set it explicitly
findings.problem: Column default is 'client'; any server-originated insert that omits detection_source would be mislabeled as client, defeating the required client-vs-server separation.
findings.fix: State that all server-originated inserts set detection_source explicitly ('server'); the default exists only for backward compatibility of the existing /violation path.
